"What does this mean?"

The first person has the key.  They may be scared because it doesn't fit any lock in their house.  Then, the second person has the key too.  The two people can come together and open a new door, and see what happens on the other side.  This new door can lead to a new adventure.  They can start a whole new story with the key.

In this story, there are two main characters.  They work together to solve a problem and find an answer.  The characters start out confused and scared.  They also change because they were able to come up with an answer to a problem.  This story has a moral of problem solving and using teamwork to overcome problems.

A good title for the story could be "The Key that Didn't Fit Any Lock."

"Do I owe you anything?"

"Please let her go," he cries.
Then the line goes dead. And the man sobs, alone.
